hard_target_disposition: RESTRICTED_SUPPORT_COMPRESSION_PROVED: for every fixed public kappa>=1, the N-blind full layer m=max(2,ceil((kappa N)^(1/6))) has O_kappa(N^(1/3)) cells and contains a coordinate of every prime divisor whenever P^+(N)^2<=kappa N; this includes all prime powers and every fixed-balance semiprime family q/p<=kappa.
unresolved_residue: Universal arbitrary-imbalance compression is not supplied by this full-layer construction. Exact visibility is p<=m^3+m+1; for N=2q with q asymptotic to N/2, forcing every prime factor visible in one full layer needs m=Omega(N^(1/3)) and m^2=Omega(N^(2/3)) cells. A genuinely N-native factor-independent adaptive selector using fewer cells remains open.
next_control_plane_recommendation: Driver review RR-2A4E099EAD6A017F1272. If accepted, benchmark the O_kappa(N^(1/3)) fixed-balance/smooth-family support and gcd interface; preserve p>m^3+m+1 and N=2018,kappa=4 as no-overclaim guards. Any successor should seek an N-native adaptive selector or rigorously prove its impossibility.
